PLATE_ECONOMY: Sixteen new station plates. Shared material DNA (olive, burgundy, brass, cream, stone, walnut). No plate reused from the first batch. Each plate is the new authority with live words and controls removed.
COPY_SOURCE: src/projects/jurnl/runtime/screens/SetupScreens.tsx and src/projects/jurnl/data/f02/screens.ts. Image lettering is guidance. Source truth stays canonical.
